Discover Pure Neem Powder for Your Business

Neem powder is made from dried leaves of the Azadirachta indica tree. It is bought in bulk by cosmetic makers, agricultural formulators and herbal product brands. If you are comparing the neem powder price per kg from Indian suppliers, Tradenest Naturals offers fine green leaf powder in export packing. Our pure neem leaf powder bulk supply is clean, evenly milled and consistent in colour. As a neem powder exporter, we share clear specifications so you know exactly what you are buying. We process carefully selected leaves with simple, controlled steps. Whether you need wholesale neem powder for cosmetics, agriculture or herbal products, we can pack it to suit your line. Send us your requirements and we will prepare a quote.

Processing & Quality Control

Our process pairs traditional herbal know-how with modern drying and milling equipment. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers across India. Our team cleans and dehydrates the leaves under hygienic conditions, then mills and sieves them. The result is our neem powder 100 mesh grade, with a standard specification of 80-100 mesh and an even particle size.
  • Moisture is kept at or below 8% to reduce clumping in storage.
  • Careful grinding helps keep the natural green colour of the leaf.
  • A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation.
  • Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Key Applications Across Diverse Industries

Neem powder is a versatile ingredient in several sectors. Cosmetic manufacturers use it in face masks, herbal shampoos and soaps. Agricultural formulators blend it into garden and soil care products. Herbal brands use it in traditional Ayurvedic formulations.
  • Cosmetics: face packs, hair care products and skin cleansers.
  • Agriculture: plant-based garden products, repellent blends and soil conditioners.
  • Ayurveda: traditional herbal capsules, tablets and churna blends.
  • Private Label: custom-branded retail packs for D2C brands.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for neem powder price per kg?

Our MOQ is 5 Kg for standard packing. Private label runs are quoted based on your packaging and volume.

What are the typical specifications of your neem powder?

Our standard neem powder is dehydrated and milled to 80-100 mesh, with moisture at or below 8%. It has a fine green appearance and a characteristic bitter taste.

What packaging and shelf-life options are available?

We offer export-ready bulk bags, HDPE drums and custom retail pouches. Stored in cool, dry conditions, the powder has a shelf life of 24 months.
